title: DragonWilds: Ghornfell Agility Course Gold Medal Guide (KBM & Controller)
author: Nerdy But Deadly
description:
A complete walkthrough for the Ghornfell agility course in RuneScape: Dragonwilds. 

This guide includes full voice commentary and accurate closed captions (CC). 

Strategies are broken down for both Keyboard & Mouse (KBM) and Xbox Controller players to secure an easy Gold Medal!

Congratulations 🎉🎊🎈 

Let’s hear your PB’s Below! ⬇️

transcript.text: Hey guys, Nerdy but Deadly here and covering the Iorwerth agility course uh agility course on keyboard and mouse
and Xbox controller as well in the Fractured Planes region which will require level 15 agility
along with wind step and the double jump. I'm going to guide you along and getting a gold
like I said on both console and on um PC. So, go ahead and join me along. Let's go.
Run. Double jump. Double jump.
Dodge these. Dodge the rock. Double jump. Double jump.
Single jump. Fall. Double jump.
Hit that. Make sure you don't hit that till you fell off the pedestal. Run. Double jump early. Double jump early.
Run. Dodge. Dodge. Single jump. There's a bird. Dodge the bird. Double jump. Double jump. Double jump.
Open your thing. Hit your thing. Jump as soon as possible. Run. And hit it. Got a gold. Right on. All
done. Good to go. Now to the controller.
Run. Run. Run. Run. Double jump. Double jump.
Double jump. Double jump. Single jump. Fall.
Double jump. Push Y. Hit A. Jump. Land.
Run forward. Run forward. Double jump. Double jump.
Single jump. Dodge all these. Double jump. Double jump. Double jump. Push Y. Hit A.
Jump. Land. Double jump and good.
And that was my fastest time yet on a controller. Wow.
Don't say you can't do it. Anything's possible. You can beat your even your keyboard and mouse time
on a controller with enough practice and enough fails. Keep at it. You're welcome.
Hopefully you enjoyed the guide. And hopefully you guys keep with it and got a bunch of experience and
all that good stuff. See you in the next one in the Highlands.
